tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of any webpage. Returns the image as base64-encoded data.

url.description: URL of the webpage to capture

fullPage.description: Capture the full scrollable page instead of just the viewport

blockCookieBanners.description: Attempt to dismiss or hide cookie consent banners

tools.name: pdf
tools.description: Generate a PDF from a URL or raw HTML. Returns the PDF as base64-encoded data.

url.description: URL of the webpage to convert to PDF (provide url or html, not both)

html.description: Raw HTML string to convert to PDF (provide url or html, not both)

headerTemplate.description: HTML template for the page header

footerTemplate.description: HTML template for the page footer

tools.name: metadata
tools.description: Extract metadata from any webpage — title, description, Open Graph tags, Twitter Cards, JSON-LD structured data, favicon, canonical URL, and more.

url.description: URL of the webpage to extract metadata from
